svg.title: Plant cell
svg.desc: Chloroplast, Small vacuole, Nucleus, Cytoplasm, Large vacuole

g.title: Chloroplast
g.desc: The small round organelle in the upper right.

g.title: Small vacuole
g.desc: The oval organelle on the left side of the cell.

g.title: Nucleus
g.desc: The round organelle near the middle of the cell.

g.title: Cytoplasm
g.desc: The large area inside the cell wall.

g.title: Large vacuole
g.desc: The oval organelle in the lower right.
